name: zplc
description: ZPLC - Open Source IEC 61131-3 PLC Runtime

scripts.setup: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build:compiler && bun run build:runtime
scripts.build: bun run build:compiler && bun run build:ide
scripts.test: bun run test:compiler && bun run test:ide
scripts.build:runtime: cmake -S firmware/lib/zplc_core -B firmware/lib/zplc_core/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build firmware/lib/zplc_core/build --target zplc_runtime --parallel
scripts.test:core: cmake -S firmware/lib/zplc_core -B build/core-sanitized -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug "-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=-fsanitize=address,undefined,float-cast-overflow -fno-sanitize-recover=undefined,float-cast-overflow -fno-omit-frame-pointer" && cmake --build build/core-sanitized --parallel && ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1 ctest --test-dir build/core-sanitized --output-on-failure
scripts.test:compiler:ci: mkdir -p build/ci && status=0; bun run test:compiler -- --reporter=junit "--reporter-outfile=$PWD/build/ci/junit-compiler.xml" || status=$?; bun tools/ci/check-expected-failures.ts --exit-code $status "packages/zplc-compiler=$PWD/build/ci/junit-compiler.xml"
scripts.test:ide:ci: mkdir -p build/ci && status=0; bun run test:ide -- --reporter=junit "--reporter-outfile=$PWD/build/ci/junit-ide.xml" || status=$?; bun tools/ci/check-expected-failures.ts --exit-code $status "packages/zplc-ide=$PWD/build/ci/junit-ide.xml"
scripts.test:ci: bun run test:compiler:ci && bun run test:ide:ci
scripts.dev: bun run build:runtime && bun run --cwd=packages/zplc-ide electron:dev
scripts.check:typescript: bun run build:compiler && bun run test:compiler && bun run typecheck && bun run build:ide && bun run test:ide && bun run lint:ide
scripts.check:docs: python3 tools/docs/test_generate_known_limits.py && python3 tools/docs/generate_known_limits.py --check && bun run docs:generate && bun run docs:validate && python3 tools/docs/test_validate_docs_pages.py && python3 tools/docs/validate_docs_pages.py && bun run docs:build
scripts.release:rehearsal: bun run check:versions && bun test scripts/release-version.test.ts && node --test scripts/release-artifacts.test.mjs && node --test scripts/workflow-action-pins.test.mjs && python3 tools/hil/audit_repo_hygiene.py && python3 tools/hil/validate_release_evidence.py && python3 tools/hil/validate_supported_boards.py && bun run contract:check
scripts.contract:check: python3 tools/contract/generate.py --check && python3 tools/contract/test_contract.py && bun test ./tools/contract
